description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'DelegateTarget' that implements the 'Target' interface. It serves as a delegator class, extending or modifying behavior by delegating method calls to an underlying 'Target' instance. The class is used within the 'org.eclipse.ditto.model.connectivity' package to facilitate protocol-specific extensions of the Target concept.
